comment: The machine mirror of the path rules that config/workflow.md states in prose. workflow.md stays the human-readable source and wins every disagreement: change it first, then change this file to match. The hooks read this file so that a path question is answered the same way every time, instead of being re-inferred from prose on every turn. Matching uses fnmatch, so '*' crosses a directory separator: write '*/tests/*' and 'tests/*' as two patterns when you mean both. A glob that holds no '/' is also matched against the file name alone, so 'test_*.py' matches 'apps/wallet/tests/test_limit.py'. In this release two sets are read: protect_human_owned reads 'human_owned', and bin/craft-spec trace reads 'tests' to find the test files it maps to acceptance criteria. The spec gate (gate_spec) needs no glob set: it gates every path outside .claude/. The other five sets are recorded here for a route guard that is not wired yet. Nothing reads them today, so an entry there changes no behavior.
